author: Bellular News
description:
Meccha Chameleon sold 15 million copies in a month, but Roblox games based on it appeared within a day and rapidly reached tens of millions of visits. Its success exposes a much larger split between the gaming world we talk about and the one its future audience already inhabits.

Join us at https://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
